# @neural-ng/core/checkbox

Angular 22+ standalone native binary and tri-state Checkbox Beta controls.

IMPORT
import {
  NeuralCheckbox,
  NeuralTriStateCheckbox,
} from '@neural-ng/core/checkbox';

BINARY
<neural-checkbox [(checked)]="accepted">
  I accept the terms
</neural-checkbox>

TRI-STATE
<neural-tri-state-checkbox [(value)]="permission">
  Inherit permission
</neural-tri-state-checkbox>

FORMS
<neural-checkbox [formField]="form.accepted">Accept</neural-checkbox>
<neural-checkbox [formControl]="acceptedControl">Accept</neural-checkbox>
<neural-checkbox name="accepted" [(ngModel)]="accepted">Accept</neural-checkbox>

<neural-tri-state-checkbox [formField]="form.permission">
  Inherit
</neural-tri-state-checkbox>

RULES
- NeuralCheckbox implements FormCheckboxControl.
- Binary checked is always boolean and generates checkedChange.
- Binary `indeterminate` is presentation-only for partial collection
  selection. It maps to native indeterminate plus aria-checked="mixed" and
  never changes the boolean checked model.
- NeuralTriStateCheckbox implements FormValueControl<boolean | null>.
- Never generate the deprecated CheckboxComponent or
  TriStateCheckboxComponent aliases.
- Tri-state value generates valueChange and cycles false -> true -> null -> false.
- null means mixed and maps to the native indeterminate property plus
  aria-checked="mixed".
- Do not add triState back to neural-checkbox and do not bind nullable data to
  checked.
- Do not invent a separate indeterminate model for tri-state; tri-state value
  is authoritative.
- stateChange is a user-only semantic event. Programmatic form/model writes do
  not emit it.
- disabled removes interaction. readonly remains focusable and blocks mutation.
- touch emits when the native input blurs.
- Preserve the real input[type=checkbox], projected label, native Space
  activation, required, name, value, focus, and form behavior.
- Use ariaLabel when there is no visible projected label.
- Both components share --neural-checkbox-* theme tokens.
- Use unstyled or global provideNeuralNg({ unstyled: true }) for headless mode.
- Inside neural-field, inherit accessible ids, descriptions, and field state.
- The components are SSR/hydration safe. Call focus() only from browser-side
  interaction code.
- Beta boundary: Checkbox owns native binary/tri-state input behavior and form
  integration. Business validation and group semantics belong to the consumer
  or Neural Field.
